meta.source: NHS Organisation Data Service, ORD API 2-0-0 (organisations with a postcode starting E14)
meta.licence_checked: feeds/feeds.json entry nhs-ods-ord (OGL v3, 2026-10-03); the digital.nhs.uk page is behind a Cloudflare challenge for this client, so the statement was not re-read today
meta.attribution: Contains NHS Organisation Data Service data, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
meta.method: One list query (PostCode=E14, Limit=1000, active and inactive), then one detail request per organisation for address, UPRN, operational dates and roles. GP practices are "Prescribing Cost Centre" with the non-primary role RO76 (GP PRACTICE). No coordinates: positions are ONSPD postcode centres.
meta.membership: in_box: the source coordinate lies in the box, or (no source coordinate) the ONSPD centre of the postcode does; in_e14: postcode district E14. Kept: either.
